steps.js: const pop=document.querySelector('.v3-pop:has(> .sb-music)')||document.querySelector('.sb-music')?.closest('.v3-pop'); if(!pop) return 'no popover'; const sc=[...pop.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>{const s=getComputedStyle(e); return /(auto|scroll)/.test(s.overflowY)&&e.scrollHeight>e.clientHeight+4;}); const ps=getComputedStyle(pop); return {popH:Math.round(pop.getBoundingClientRect().height), popOverflow:ps.overflowY, popScrolls:pop.scrollHeight>pop.clientHeight+4, innerScrollers:sc.map(e=>String(e.className).split(' ')[0]+' '+e.clientHeight+'/'+e.scrollHeight)};
